principle: Accession associations remain provenance, never the sole location or access protocol for knowledge.
antiGaming: Full-fidelity bytes alone do not satisfy semantic disposition completeness.
Extracted semantics alone do not satisfy reversible source-object recovery.
Removing an accession artifact cannot improve migration completeness.
Historical branch, commit, path, and Git blob identifiers may appear only as provenance after materialization.
A privacy boundary cannot be weakened to improve parity or retrieval.
A source evaluation remains situated knowledge even when it is not promoted into the active Atlas suite.
Human interpretive review cannot be self-certified by an automated agent.
releaseCondition: Every accession artifact has a native source object, structural profile, knowledge-class disposition, native targets, closed provenance, and no known residual knowledge. Human fidelity gates remain separately fail-closed.
